lines.rookie:
Rome is old and quiet.
But something is wrong.
lines.junior:
Rome is ancient and calm.
But something has gone wrong.
lines.master:
Ancient Rome lies still.
Yet something is amiss.

lines.rookie: A piece of an old map is gone.
lines.junior: An ancient map has lost a piece.

lines.rookie: Owl cards appear in the city.
lines.master: Owl cards surface across the city.

lines.rookie: A box holds strange white dust.
lines.junior: A box is full of strange white dust.
lines.master: A box conceals a curious white dust.

lines.rookie: And a night log hides a secret.
lines.junior: And a guard's night log hides a secret.
lines.master: And a night log guards a secret.
They appear to be unrelated cases.

lines.rookie:
But a good detective
puts the pieces together.
lines.junior:
But a great detective
fits the pieces together.
lines.master:
But a great detective
sees how the pieces belong.

lines.junior: What if the pieces fit together?
lines.master: What if every piece belongs together?

lines.rookie:
Every clue may be a piece
of one old map.
lines.junior:
Every clue could be a piece
of one ancient map.
lines.master:
Each clue may be a fragment
of one forgotten map.

lines.rookie:
Your first case starts
at the museum.
lines.junior:
Your first investigation
begins at the museum.
lines.master:
Your first investigation
awaits at the museum.

lines.rookie: The real piece is back in its glass case.
lines.junior: The real piece is finally back in its glass case.
lines.master: At last, the genuine piece rests once more in its glass case.

lines.rookie: Under Piazza della Civetta, an old Roman library sees the light again.
lines.junior: Beneath Piazza della Civetta, an old Roman library sees daylight once again.
lines.master: Beneath Piazza della Civetta, a long-forgotten Roman library emerges into the light once more.

lines.rookie: Rome keeps its stories under its streets.
lines.junior: Rome hides its stories under its streets.
lines.master: Rome keeps its oldest stories buried beneath its streets.

lines.rookie: This time, you found one piece by piece.
lines.junior: This time, you uncovered one, piece by piece.
lines.master: This time, you brought one back to light, piece by piece.
